verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is Luma Skills, which lets a user build a reusable creative workflow they can run again. Nothing documents scheduling that workflow on a recurring cadence (cron, timers, triggers), so a reusable one-off run is not a recurring schedule. Scheduling is a fair axis for an agent-driven creative platform, so the verdict is none, not na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Introducing Luma Skills: Build a Creative Workflow Once, Run It Forever
